MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 31
   C. 25
   D. 27

4. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 6
   D. 11

5. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

6. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 82

9. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 12

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170

   D. 169

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
